name: Mohen_01_Rainy_Bamboo_Pavilion
category: 水墨武侠《墨痕》- 镜1 远景雨夜竹亭温酒
prompt:
Masterpiece Chinese ink wash painting animation, traditional sumi-e wuxia aesthetic, rich rice paper texture, visible Xuan paper fibers, five shades of ink from deep scorched soot to translucent grey washes, vast negative space and zen void.

Scene: Extreme wide landscape establishing shot of a secluded stone pavilion nestled deep within a misty bamboo forest in the pouring rain. An elderly white-haired swordsman named Mo Yin, dressed in flowing loose ash-grey Taoist robes with wide sleeves, sits peacefully alone beside a rough stone table, quietly warming rice wine. Delicate wisps of white steam softly rise from the ceramic wine kettle.

A single delicate vermilion red lantern hangs from the eaves of the stone pavilion, softly glowing and swaying gently in the night breeze, serving as the sole vibrant color accent in an otherwise monochrome ink world.

Camera: Extremely slow, graceful cinematic push-in through cascading rain streaks, rain beads rolling off bamboo leaves.

Audio: Crisp stereophonic rain drumming against bamboo stalks, rhythmic dripping from pavilion eaves, distant low rolling thunder, deep resonant antique Guqin bass notes setting a meditative wuxia tone.

Negative: Western oil painting, 3D CGI render, photorealism, glossy plastic, modern elements, loud saturated colors except the red lantern, text watermark, subtitles, distorted limbs.

name: Mohen_02_Qingfeng_Approach
category: 水墨武侠《墨痕》- 镜2 中景跟拍青锋踏雨
prompt:
Masterpiece Chinese ink wash painting animation, traditional sumi-e wuxia aesthetic, rough fibrous rice paper texture, bold flying-white calligraphy brushstrokes, ink bloom diffusion effects.

Scene: Medium tracking shot of young swordsman Qing Feng walking deliberately through the rain toward the stone pavilion. He wears a wide-brimmed conical bamboo hat (douli), a tight dark teal and ink-black martial arts tunic, and carries a slender unsheathed straight sword at his waist. With each heavy purposeful step on the wet stone steps, dark ink wash splashes up realistically, rippling outward like dissolving watercolor. His robes flutter with ink vapor.

Camera: Smooth vertical tilt-up starting from wet boots stepping into rain puddles, panning up along his taut figure, ending on a close-up of his resolute, sharp, furious eyes partially shadowed beneath the bamboo hat brim.

Audio: Splashing wet footsteps on stone, soft friction of damp silk cloth, subtle metallic slide of sword hilt in sheath, ambient continuous rain.

Negative: 3D anime CGI, bright garish colors, Western medieval knight, text, subtitles, watermark, distorted eyes.

name: Mohen_03_Standoff_Gazes
category: 水墨武侠《墨痕》- 镜3 双人对峙与眼神特写
prompt:
Masterpiece Chinese ink wash painting animation, traditional sumi-e wuxia aesthetic, minimalist composition, five shades of ink, rice paper grain.

Scene: Tense standoff inside the open rain pavilion. The elderly white-haired master Mo Yin slowly lifts his calm, weathered, enlightened eyes without moving his posture. Standing opposite him in the rain, young swordsman Qing Feng grips his sword hilt firmly, knuckles turning pale. Extreme tension in the air. Rain pours outside the stone pillars. The vermilion red lantern casts subtle warm reflections on their weathered faces.

Camera: Cinematic slow horizontal tracking shot, shifting focus between Qing Feng's tense fingers hovering over the sword hilt and Mo Yin's profound, still, peaceful gaze.

Audio: Rain sounds gradually lowering into muffled silence, a solitary resonant Guqin note ringing in acoustic isolation, faint low-frequency martial heartbeat drum building tension.

Negative: 3D render, cartoonish expressions, text subtitles, blood, plastic smooth skin.

name: Mohen_04_Clash_Ink_Burst
category: 水墨武侠《墨痕》- 镜4 拔剑交锋与飞白墨爆
prompt:
Masterpiece Chinese ink wash painting animation, dynamic traditional sumi-e wuxia action, wild cursive calligraphy strokes, flying-white (feibai) brushwork, ink spatter bursts.

Scene: Dynamic slow-motion combat sequence. Qing Feng unsheathes his steel sword in a blinding flash, lunging forward with a piercing thrust. Old master Mo Yin calmly sidesteps with fluid graceful footwork, his wide sleeves billowing like flowing grey clouds. As their blades collide, instead of metal sparks, spectacular explosive bursts of pitch-black ink droplets and sweeping wild brush strokes shatter into the air like fractured ink calligraphy across raw rice paper. Raindrops split in mid-air.

Camera: Kinetic slow-motion 180-degree semicircular orbiting shot tracking the blade clash and the spiraling ink explosion.

Audio: Sharp metallic sword unsheathing ringing chime, heavy iron clash 'clang', satisfying wet ink burst 'splat' resonance, powerful cinematic wuxia battle drum crescendo.

Negative: Blood, fire sparks, Western fantasy magic effects, 3D CGI video game look, text, subtitles.

name: Mohen_05_Two_Fingers_Catch_Blade
category: 水墨武侠《墨痕》- 镜5 特写双指夹剑尖
prompt:
Masterpiece Chinese ink wash painting animation, traditional sumi-e wuxia action, exquisite fine-line brushwork (gongbi combined with xieyi), rice paper texture.

Scene: Extreme close-up of supreme martial art mastery. Qing Feng unleashes a furious thrust aiming straight between Mo Yin's eyebrows. The blade rushes through the falling rain. With immaculate serenity, Mo Yin tilts his head slightly sideways and raises two fingers (index and middle finger), catching the flying sword tip firmly between his calloused fingers! The sword blade vibrates violently, sending ring-like ink shockwaves rippling through the rain.

Camera: Rapid punch-in transitioning into dramatic ultra-slow-motion hold on the two fingers clamping the steel blade tip, one inch before Mo Yin's forehead.

Audio: Slicing wind of the sword, fluttering silk robe, rapid wuxia drums instantly cutting to dead silence, an eerie lingering high-pitched steel blade vibration hum.

Negative: Blood, cuts, gore, 3D cartoon, glowing energy beams, text subtitles, watermark.

name: Mohen_06_Ink_Shockwave_Bamboo_Leaves
category: 水墨武侠《墨痕》- 镜6 墨色气浪与漫天飞叶
prompt:
Masterpiece Chinese ink wash painting animation, traditional sumi-e wuxia aesthetic, vast atmospheric ink wash, rice paper texture.

Scene: Close-up to medium shot. Mo Yin delivers a subtle flick with his two fingers against the blade. Thousands of emerald and ink-colored bamboo leaves are ripped from the grove, swirling in a grand vortex through the rain. Qing Feng is pushed back half a step by the overwhelming inner force, sword lowered. The sword tip trembles.

Camera: Medium slow-motion shot tracking the expanding circular ink vapor ring and swirling spiral of bamboo leaves floating past the lens.

Audio: Deep seismic sub-bass 'whoosh' pulse, rushing wind rustling through dense bamboo, thousands of leaves whistling in air, isolated heavy water drops falling.

Negative: Western explosive fireball, CGI particle overload, blood, modern armor, text subtitles.

name: Mohen_07_Farewell_Kneeling_Respect
category: 水墨武侠《墨痕》- 镜7 墨隐收剑与青锋跪拜
prompt:
Masterpiece Chinese ink wash painting animation, traditional sumi-e wuxia aesthetic, poetic atmosphere, rice paper texture, five shades of ink.

Scene: Medium shot inside the tranquil rain-drenched pavilion. Behind him, young swordsman Qing Feng drops to one knee in the soaking rain, bowing deeply with sword held across his palms in heartfelt respect and enlightenment. Camera: Medium static tableau shot capturing the emotional departure, slow subtle pan toward the lone red lantern hanging from the pavilion pillar.

name: Mohen_08_Zen_Void_Negative_Space
category: 水墨武侠《墨痕》- 镜8 远景宣纸留白与山水归隐
prompt:
Masterpiece Chinese ink wash painting animation, ultimate traditional sumi-e aesthetic, extreme artistic negative space, expansive white Xuan paper void, delicate minimalist brush marks.

Scene: The rain ceases completely. The dense mountain fog and mist gradually dissolve into thin ethereal ribbons of pale grey ink wash. The distant stone pavilion and the tiny dot of the vermilion red lantern grow smaller and smaller, melting harmoniously into an immense expanse of untouched white rice paper. The grand bamboo mountains fade into poetic horizon lines.

Camera: Extremely slow, grand cinematic crane-out pulling endlessly backward and upward, letting the landscape dissolve into meditative blank void.

Audio: Soulful bamboo Xiao flute finishing on a long fading note, delicate lingering harmonics of an ancient Guqin, one final crystal-clear water droplet echoing in absolute stillness.

Negative: Cluttered background, busy details, modern objects, bright colors, text watermark, subtitles, 3D CGI.
